results.intentUsed:
Exercise profile and notification settings, submit invalid and valid data, reload after saving, and inspect whether feedback and fields remain usable.

Work through these checks in order, and record what you actually observe for each:
1. Type distinct values into Full name, Email address, and Company fields. — expect: Each profile field must remain identifiable by a visible label after its placeholder disappears.
2. Enter Taylor, taylor@example.com, Acme, choose Weekly, and enter “Call after 5pm”; note all five values. Then Save, wait for confirmation, reload, and reread every control. — expect: Confirmation must appear; after reload, all five values must remain unchanged.
3. Enter Full name Taylor and email alex@example (missing only the domain suffix). Then Submit the form. — expect: A visible error must require a valid email address, with no saved confirmation.
4. Leave Full name empty; enter the plausible email alex@example.com. Then Submit the form. — expect: A visible error must state that full name is required, with no saved confirmation.
